overview_description.description:
We Are Harris Pye
The Harris Pye Engineering Group is a rapidly expanding global organisation specialising in the provision of repairs, upgrades and conversions to the marine, offshore oil and gas and associated onshore industrial sectors. Operating worldwide on a 24/7 basis, our philosophy is to provide a global service with a focus on supplying top quality products and fast and efficient customer service.

about_short_description.short_description: Harris Pye is an energy company that provides engineering and project management services to marine, offshore, and industrial sectors.

product.name: Boiler Services
product.description: Comprehensive repair, maintenance, upgrade, and installation services for boilers and associated steam systems in marine, offshore, and industrial sectors.

product.name: Remnant Life Assessment (RLA)
product.description: Assessment of in-service degradation and remaining life of boiler and pressure vessel components under thermal, pressure, and cyclic stresses.

product.name: Boiler Circulation Analysis
product.description: Computer-based assessment of internal water circulation in sub-critical boilers to optimize performance and detect issues.

identifier.value: Boiler Design, Tender Preparation, Contract and Site Administration

product.name: Boiler Design, Tender Preparation, Contract and Site Administration
product.description: Design and project management services for new boiler construction, including tendering, contract supervision, commissioning, and training.

product.name: Harris Pye Steam Boilers
product.description: Custom-designed steam boilers primarily for marine use, adaptable for power and process steam applications.

product.name: Extended Heating Surfaces – Boiler Components
product.description: Design and manufacture of plain and extended surface tubes for boiler economisers and heat exchangers.
